text: You have the insolence to talk to me of differences, Henry?” Oh, the uselessness of it! Henry’s retort came. “I perceive you are attempting blackmail. It is scarcely a pretty weapon for a wife to use against her husband. My rule through life has been never to pay the least attention to threats, and I can only repeat what I said before: I do not give you and your sister leave to sleep at Howards End.” Margaret loosed his hands.
